name: Pack I-Surf Compact
subtitle: Inflatable surf for small waves. Available in 5’0 and 5’6.
description:
A complete pack includes:
a board, GONG SURF INFLATABLE COMPACT (size of your choice).
a GONG leash, adapted to boards size (colour of your choice).
Program:
Inflatable surfboard type funboard, compact and dedicated to small waves.
Presentation:
The GONG SURF INFLATABLE COMPACT is perfect for summer waves.
It paddles fast for its size because it is thick. When you take off, you just have to plant the tail a little to start in three paddle strokes. Its surfing qualities are surprising with a one third very wide rear to accelerate, which naturally generates a lot of speed. And paradoxically, it turns really well thanks to its small size, which is very playful. For an inflatable board, the surfing performances are amazing.
It’s the ideal board for soft waves, but also for hollow shorebreaks which require a small board to slide down the slope gently. Its range of use is therefore really wide and will cover most of the summer sessions.
Safety is a key argument on this range of inflatable boards. Storage is obviously an asset, but the protection of the inflatable against impacts for both the surfer and the board itself are a real plus.
A truly original board for an unbelievable pleasure without the constraints of a rigid board!
2 boards from 5’0 to 5’6 for all sizes. With the surfs GONG Inflatable Compact, you have a board at the forefront of modernity, solid, dynamic, of high quality, and all this without breaking the bank thanks to our online sales system (direct sale from the shaper to the foiler, without intermediary).
The 5’0 x 55L is intended for intermediate levels with small to medium builds.
The 5’6 x 62L is intended for beginners with small to medium builds but also for more advanced and heavier surfers.
